definitions.explanation: The darkness that falls in the evening as the sun sets. A literary and evocative word for the dimness of dusk.

examples.japanese: {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}って→迫る：03928_semaru⟧きた。
{夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked alone in the evening darkness.

examples.japanese: {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ぽつぽつ→ぽつぽつ：06683_potsupotsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{明|あ}かり→明かり：01681_akari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{灯|とも}り→灯る：13381_tomoru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: In the town wrapped in evening darkness, lights began to flicker on one by one.

notes:
A literary and poetic word. {夕闇|ゆうやみ} evokes atmosphere and mood more than a simple time reference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: evening darkness approaches
- {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in evening darkness
- {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the evening darkness
- {夕闇|ゆうやみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧: to slip away under cover of dusk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧: evening, dusk (more neutral and common)
- ⟦{薄暮|はくぼ}→薄暮：10198_hakubo⟧: dim twilight (formal/literary)
- ⟦{黄昏|たそがれ}→黄昏：05046_tasogare⟧: twilight, dusk (literary; also figuratively "decline")
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: evening (everyday term)

REGISTER:
Literary. Common in novels, poetry, and descriptive writing. Rarely used in casual conversation, where ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧ or ⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた would be more natural.
